# Summary

Describe the user/repository outcome and why it belongs in this change.

## Verification

List fresh commands and results. Include focused tests plus `pnpm verify` when the change is ready.

## Risk and boundaries

- [ ] No real report, project, evidence, credential, personal information, or incident data is included.
- [ ] No certification, approval, eligibility guarantee, or automatic completion claim is introduced.
- [ ] Official text/source and Ancilis guidance remain separate.
- [ ] Project content remains local by default; no new network, analytics, third-party script, remote parser, or remote AI path exists.
- [ ] Imported/user/document strings remain data and are escaped/validated for every output context.
- [ ] Documentation and release notes cover behavior, privacy, security, migration, deployment, or regulatory changes as applicable.

## Required review

- [ ] Tests were written before implementation for behavior changes and the expected failure was observed.
- [ ] Keyboard, screen reader semantics, focus, contrast, reduced motion, zoom, responsive, and print impacts were reviewed for user-interface changes.
- [ ] Regulatory content reviewer requested for rule/schema/applicability/guidance changes.
- [ ] Security reviewer requested for storage, parser, import/export, crypto, generated content, CSP, contact, dependency, or trust-boundary changes.
- [ ] Acme Metrics remains fictional and every sample output remains watermarked.

## Screenshots or output evidence

Use fictional data only. Add evidence when the change affects visible UI, print, generated artifacts, or host headers.

## Known limitations

State any residual limitation or write “No new limitation introduced.”
